topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Ran into a fella today, down at the yard sale on Maple, who came across his old teddy. Sun was popping through the overcast, just a sliver, but enough to dust the place with something warm. He was standing there, bear clutched like he was a kid again, eyes not really seeing the passersby. In the city, we’re used to seeing peopleclutching things they need, mostly cash or a bottle, but this was different. He told me he hadn’t seen that bear in over thirty years. Thirty years. Said it smelled like old pages and rain. I nodded, because sometimes, in the rain-soaked streets, you catch a scent and it’s like time gums up, and the next thing you know, you’re back in a place you thought you left behind. He paid for the bear, like it was a precious relic, and walked away, a little slower, carrying more than the price of a yard sale find.
